question: Pointing to a lady, Raman said, "The son of her only brother is the brother of my wife". How is the lady related to Raman?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87a56de162e9b334490db7733674e7aef59028f5f8143051317e0f129848f304.png] 

Given that,

Raman pointed to a lady and said that the son of her only brother is the brother of Raman's wife.

Based on the data given, the following family tree diagram can be drawn,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd1eb8b44ad4bf4222914e4628a2df7a655e7840428796aff2f066958caa417c.png] 

According to the family tree diagram, the lady is Raman's wife's father's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Wife's father's sister"**.
